_why: THE FRAME COMPOSITIONS. Three components that take a STILL and compose a frame around it.
_measured: An `image`-typed property delivers a URL STRING, measured by frame 2026-09-21 (measured/mg_runtime_capabilities_2026-09-19.md, second run). You pass an asset id in the override and the component receives the resolved URL, so every `still` default is the empty string and the body guards on it rather than inventing one.
_how_this_is_read: MEASURED after writing it, and it corrects what I assumed. I put these rows here because PORTED_PROPS lives in chatcut_job_app.py and that is not my file — I expected the harness entry to be wired separately. It is not: the harness MERGES every port/*_properties.json into PORTED_PROPS at import, and its own comment says to ship `<family>_properties.json` beside the body and it will be picked up. So this file is already live; `PORT_PROPS_LOADED.added` lists all three. I followed a convention I did not know existed, which is luck, not method — the convention is written down here now.
_options_shape: Bare strings are CORRECT here. The harness's normalise_properties converts them to {value,label} objects, which is the shape ChatCut's registration tool demands — it rejects bare strings outright. Two surfaces with a normaliser between them, so do not 'fix' this table to match the API.
